The '''Kalab system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalab]].
